# tuna_public_key (Resource)

An SSH public key for tunnel authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tuna_public_key" "laptop" {
  description = "work laptop"
  public_key  = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Description of the key.
- `public_key` (String) Public key in OpenSSH format. Not returned by the API after creation.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `fingerprint` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `type` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tuna_public_key.laptop 123
```
